Returns active classification buckets with optional tag lists. Each bucket carries its canonical `type`, accepted `alias[]` spellings, `tagCount`, and (when includeTags=true) the active `tag[]`. Use bucketType to scope to one bucket and includeTags=false to fetch metadata only. For tag ids, prefer `classifications tags --type <bucket> --q <name>` over broad catalog JSON; use returned tag.id as EntityClassificationMutation.tagId when writing classifications. Dormant registry tags are intentionally omitted; type + name writes that find one return 409 with inactiveTagOverride recovery choices.

Returns one company or other entity detail record by exact id, slug, strict URL, or deterministic candidate signals. A unique exact normalized brand/legal-name match, a stored-URL match returned as the sole candidate, or one guaranteed identity match with no competing review-level candidate resolves directly. This is identity resolution, not keyword or plain-English discovery; use POST /v1/entities with textSearch for keywords or the search entities command (POST /v1/entities/natural-search) for a plain-English company request. Default reads hide hidden or off-sitemap entities; privileged callers can use includePrivate=true for write readback. Use GET/POST /v1/entities for filtered lists. Changed slugs return the canonical redirect. Every non-resolving outcome is documented on this operation's error responses.

200.description: Entity detail as canonical JSON or the same data rendered as compact text/plain.

400.description: Conflicting or unusable identity input: name, nameBrand, and nameLegal must identify the same entity, and exactly one identifier form may be supplied.

404.description: No entity resolved: fuzzy candidate signals below the review threshold without identity proof are exhausted, which does not prove the record is absent or safe to create — search POST /v1/entities with textSearch first (CLI: entities search --text-search). An existing but filtered row instead reports its reason as the ProblemDetail title: Entity Exists but Is Not Public (retry with includePrivate=true; CLI: --include-private true), Product Not Public: Missing Provider Relationship, or Fund Not Public: No Public Manager Firm.

409.description: Ambiguous identity: a candidate set still at the review threshold or carrying unresolved identity proof, multiple stored exact normalized-name matches, or a bare Product/Service slug shared across providers, since those are provider-pair scoped. ProblemDetail carries the candidates plus a resolution naming the duplicate-check candidates endpoint to review them (CLI: entities duplicate-check candidates list); resolve directly by entityId, by companySlug plus slug, or through the provider's productService relationship list.

post.description: Create a hidden entity for enrichment bootstrap. Requires brand name, concrete entity type, and operating status; slug may be omitted for a provisional server slug. Product and Service records cannot be created here because they must be joined to an existing provider in the same transaction; use entities create with productServiceProviderId. The created canonical public path is the slug owner; future slug or single-slug typeRecord route-prefix changes automatically redirect actual prior public paths and existing upstream redirect chains to the new canonical public path. Use entities create when canonical text, URLs, classifications, addresses, or logo media are ready. Duplicate conflicts return gate override recovery parameters after candidate review. Requires write authority.

get.description: Lists entity or person investors joined to a fundraise round, including join-level amountInvested attribution. amountInvested is a plain decimal number in the fundraise transaction currency. API and MCP request bodies use JSON numbers such as 220000 or 123456.78; aventure-cli uses --amount-invested 220000 or --amount-invested 123456.78. Do not send currency signs, currency codes, comma grouping, quoted numeric strings, or abbreviations such as 220k or 0.22M. PATCH with amountInvested:null clears the value. Use --entity-id or --entity-slug for the fundraising/portfolio company that raised the round — always a company, never the fund or investment firm that supplied the capital. For an Investment Firm's outgoing investment, pass the portfolio company that received the money here and identify the firm with --investor-entity-id or --investor-entity-slug. Use transactionId for the round id, or round plus dateAnnounced when transactionId is unknown. Investor entity/person selectors reference existing records only. Create a referenced investor entity first with POST /v1/entities/detail or a referenced investor person first with POST /v1/people/detail, then create the join.

post.description: Creates one directed relationship between two existing entities and returns the row. The created row is always isCurrent=true and isPrimary=true, so it appears in default relationship reads. relationshipType must be joinable=true from entities relationships types; its direction/sourceRole/targetRole fields describe whether source/target order is symmetric, auto-oriented, or directional. For parent, sourceEntityId is the parent and targetEntityId is the child. For affinity, sourceEntityId is the member organization and targetEntityId is the provider organization; the companies list affinity filter accepts provider names only. For productService, one side must be Product or Service and the provider side must be Company, Nonprofit, Government, or Business Line; Investment Firm, Fund, and group-only Organization are rejected because they cannot own products/services. AcquisitionManaged and readOnly types are rejected. For acceleratorParticipant, one side must be the participant entity and the other side must be the accelerator entity with typeRecord=Investment Firm; the join endpoint stores participant as source and accelerator as target. acceleratorParticipant requires detail as `batch=<label>` or `program=<name>; batch=<label>` plus asOf. Use entities relationships row create when writing historic/non-primary curation flags. Missing or malformed query parameters return 400. A relationshipType whose source/target entity-type pairing is not accepted, an acquisitionManaged or readOnly relationshipType, missing acceleratorParticipant detail/asOf, or sourceEntityId equal to targetEntityId returns 422. A productService join that would create an ambiguous Product/Service slug route, a duplicate relationship, or parent/acquisition exclusivity for the same unordered entity pair returns 409; duplicate directional conflicts name the existing row and the required sourceRole/targetRole orientation. An unresolved sourceEntityId or targetEntityId returns 404.

VISIBILITY-GATED READ: a row is returned only when BOTH the acquired and acquirer entities are publicly visible. An acquisition relationship that already exists (and is visible in the entity relationships resource) but returns 404 here means one counterpart entity is still hidden -- publish that entity (statusSitemapShow=true, statusHidePage=false) -- it is an unmet visibility prerequisite, not data-layer inconsistency or projection lag. The acquired/acquirer roles in each row are always declared explicitly in the response via the acquiredEntity and acquirerEntity fields. The role query parameter only selects which side the path entity occupies in the WHERE clause: acquired (default) lists acquisitions where the path entity was bought; acquirer lists acquisitions where the path entity was the buyer; all lists or reads both sides in one response. Writes (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) ignore role and always treat the path entity as acquired. List responses are ordered by most recent acquisition event first.

Address.description: Canonical address record for entity and person payloads

association.description: Role-period associations for this physical address

AddressMutation.description: Create or update an entity or person address association. Structured fields are canonical; fullAddress is server-synthesized and cannot be written. City-level rows require researchExhausted=true after address research is exhausted. Placeholder values and URLs in address text are rejected. Text fields are normalized: surrounding whitespace and separators are trimmed and caseless values (all-lowercase or ALL-CAPS) are title-cased. Latitude and longitude are written as a pair: an explicit pair also updates coordinates on the resolved address row, while omitted coordinates derive from the resolved location and never carry over from a previously stored address.

cityName.description: City name, resolved within the selected country; include state or region only when that country requires it.

endDate.description: Last known day this address association applied.

isCurrent.description: Deprecated legacy flag marking whether the address is currently in use.

researchExhausted.description: Allow a city-level or coarser row only when source research proves no address-line, postal, or coordinate-specific address exists.

role.description: Address association role. Domicile is a legal or registered seat, dominant is the predominant display location, origin is a founding or historical location; null means unclassified.

startDate.description: First known day this address association applied.

stateAbbrev.description: State or region abbreviation for countries that require one.

stateName.description: State or region name, resolved within the selected country when that country requires one.

confidence.description: Confidence the answer is fully supported by the cited corpus. LOW signals an abstention.

publicRoute.description: Canonical public SSR detail route when this entity is visible and routable; null when hidden, invalidly slugged, or not served by a public detail route.

publicVisible.description: Whether this entity is visible to public reads.

slug.description: Entity slug.

type.description: Entity typeRecord; null on the type-null completeness gap.

ClassificationAuditFilter.description: Filters for the standardized classification audit. Omit every field to page the full visible entity fleet, including entities with no standardized joins.

ancestorChain.description: Only entities holding both an ancestor and its descendant code inside one hierarchical standardized category (ISIC, NAICS, SIC); descendant means the ancestor code digits are a strict prefix of the descendant code digits.

category.description: Restrict to entities holding at least one join in this standardized category; matched rows still report the entity's full standardized join set.

includePrivate.description: Privileged read scope for admin callers. Includes hidden and not-yet-published entities. Defaults to private visibility for admin API key or ROLE_ADMIN callers; client-secret callers stay public.

minCount.description: Only entities with at least this many standardized joins; when omitted, entities with zero joins remain in the fleet audit.

multiplePrimary.description: Only entities holding more than one primary join inside a single standardized category.

type.description: Restrict to entities with this typeRecord, e.g. Company.

ClassificationCatalog.description: Full active entity classification taxonomy in one payload. Dormant registry tags are omitted from the catalog and surface through write-time 409 recovery instead.

ClassificationCatalogBucket.description: Classification bucket with active registry tags and accepted-spelling aliases.

alias.description: Other accepted spellings for this bucket (JSON key plus storage form, deduplicated against `type`). The /tags ?type= and /catalog ?bucketType= parameters accept any of `[type, ...alias]`. Empty when the bucket has only one canonical spelling.

bucket.description: Canonical entity-classification bucket key. Use as EntityClassificationMutation.type when creating by type plus name.

creatable.description: Whether missing values in this bucket can be created by name.

hierarchical.description: Whether the bucket has hierarchy semantics.

tag.description: Active registry tags only. Empty when includeTags=false; dormant tags are omitted and require write-time inactiveTagOverride recovery when type + name matches.

tagCount.description: Total active tags in this bucket. Populated regardless of `includeTags` so callers can decide whether to fetch detail without a follow-up count query.

type.description: Canonical wire value — use as ?type= for /tags, as ?bucketType= for /catalog, and as Tag.type when round-tripping. Matches Tag.type returned in this bucket's tag[].

writable.description: Whether existing rows in this bucket can be joined.

ClassificationCatalogCategory.description: Standardized classification category with accepted spellings and registry rows.

classificationCount.description: Total standardized classifications in this category.

creatable.description: Whether missing values in this category can be created by name.

hierarchical.description: Whether the category has hierarchy semantics.

writable.description: Whether existing rows in this category can be joined.

ClassificationInactiveTagDetails.description: ProblemDetail.details for HTTP 409 when a classification value exists but is inactive.

availableOverrides.description: Allowed inactiveTagOverride values for this conflict

slug.description: Existing dormant value slug or lookup key

ClassificationJoinKey.description: One desired standardized classification join for an entity: the res_classification_ref registry id plus the primary flag inside that classification's category.

isPrimary.description: Primary join within the classification's category; default false.

standardizedClassificationId.description: Standardized classification registry id from res_classification_ref.

ClassificationReconcile.description: Reconcile result. stale rows failed the expectedHash compare-and-swap and were left untouched; failed rows hit a validation or verification error and were rolled back.

applied.description: true when apply=true executed writes; false for plan-only responses.

stale.description: Rows whose expectedHash no longer matches; resultHash is current.

ClassificationReconcileEntity.description: Desired exact standardized classification join set for one entity. The server computes the delete/patch/create diff against the current set and applies it atomically. expectedHash must match the entity's current standardized set hash from the audit endpoint or the row is reported stale and left untouched.

desiredJoin.description: Exact desired standardized join set; an empty list deletes every standardized join on the entity.

expectedHash.description: Standardized set hash the caller audited; compare-and-swap guard against concurrent writers. Obtain from the audit endpoint's expectedHash.

ClassificationReconcileMutation.description: Standardized classification reconcile request. Each entity row is applied in its own atomic transaction. apply=false (default) returns the computed plan without writing; apply=true deletes, patches, and creates joins to make the current set exactly equal the desired set, then verifies the final set before reporting success.

apply.description: false (default) computes and returns the per-entity plan without writing; true applies each plan atomically.

entity.description: Entities to reconcile; each applied independently.

ClassificationReconcileOutcome.description: Per-entity reconcile outcome: the computed (plan) or applied diff, the resulting set hash, and exact-set verification state.

message.description: Failure or staleness detail; null on success.

plan.description: Computed diff; null on stale rows and pre-diff validation failures.

resultHash.description: Standardized set hash after applying the diff; on a plan this is the hash the desired set will produce; on a stale row this is the current set hash.

verified.description: true when the post-apply set exactly equals the desired set; always false on plans, stale rows, and failures.

ClassificationReconcilePlan.description: Server-computed diff from the entity's current standardized join set to the desired set: joins to delete, primary flags to patch, and joins to create.

delete.description: Registry ids whose joins are removed from the entity.

items.description: Type-safe identifier for standardized classification rows

patch.description: Joins whose primary flag changes.

CliAuthorization.description: Browser-approved CLI authorization metadata. Secret poll and encrypted-delivery material are exposed only by their dedicated one-time response contracts.

approvedAt.description: Time the authenticated user approved this request

clientLabel.description: User-supplied label for the requesting CLI installation

comparisonCode.description: Human comparison code shown by both the CLI and browser

consumedAt.description: Time the CLI acknowledged durable local storage

expiresAt.description: Time after which an unfinished request cannot be approved

intervalSeconds.description: Minimum server-directed poll interval in seconds

keyReadyAt.description: Time encrypted key delivery became available

terminalAt.description: Time this request entered its terminal state

CliAuthorizationClientPlatform.description: Coarse operating-system family reported by the CLI

CliAuthorizationDelivery.description: RSA-wrapped AES-256-GCM delivery of one personal API-key secret

algorithm.description: Hybrid encryption suite used for this delivery

ciphertext.description: Base64-encoded encrypted UTF-8 personal API-key secret bytes

CliAuthorizationEncryptionAlgorithm.description: Versioned hybrid encryption suite for one-time CLI credential delivery

CliAuthorizationMutation.description: Creates a short-lived CLI authorization request bound to an ephemeral key

encryptionPublicKey.description: Base64-encoded DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo for an ephemeral RSA public key

CliAuthorizationPoll.description: Current broker state and encrypted delivery when the key is ready

delivery.description: Encrypted one-time delivery, present only for KEY_READY

CliAuthorizationStart.description: New CLI authorization handle and one-time poll credential

comparisonCode.description: Human comparison code shown by both the CLI and browser

pollSecret.description: One-time high-entropy credential required to poll and acknowledge delivery

enum: Credential issuance recovery revoked an unrecoverable key
Credential issuance could not be recovered
Credential issuance lost its database claim

CompletionGateCoverage.description: Coverage verdict for one completion gate on the assembled entity detail. NOT_EVALUABLE is not a failure and is not closed by evidence: the detail does not carry this gate at all, so only the gate's owningRead can grade it.

CompletionGateIndex.description: Parent row an indexed completion gate instantiates against. NONE is the flat entity-level gate that owes exactly one coverage slot; any other value owes one slot per existing row of that kind. Indexed slots are conditional on their parent rows; a server-decidable indexed slot may still be required once instantiated.

CompletionGateType.description: Canonical completion gate definition: what an enrichment run must satisfy, which read proves it, and whether it is part of the mandatory floor.

appliesToType.description: Entity type tokens the gate applies to; empty means all types.

floor.description: Whether the gate is part of the mandatory full-enrichment floor set.

indexed.description: Parent row the gate instantiates against. NONE is the flat entity-level gate; any other value owes one coverage slot per existing parent row and is never part of the flat floor set.

minCount.description: Minimum row count when the gate requires multiple rows.

owningRead.description: OpenAPI operationId of the canonical read that proves the gate.

slotRef.description: Dotted EntityDetail field path the gate reads.

unobtainableAllowed.description: Whether a source-backed unobtainable closes the gate.

Confidence.description: Three-level confidence band for a classifier, model, or probe verdict. The carrying property states what is assessed and what each band licenses.

Content.description: Canonical public content card across news, blog posts, social posts, repositories, websites, pages, and research papers.

contentId.description: Stable content id scoped by contentType.

createdAt.description: Content row creation instant when known.

publishedAt.description: Publication or source activity instant when known.

relation.description: How this content relates to the requested owner.

sourceName.description: Publication, platform owner, or source label.

summary.description: Short summary or excerpt when known.

title.description: Human title or best available display label. webPage rows restate the page URL when the crawl captured no label; renderers may humanize that fallback.

topic.description: Single canonical topic key (web-crawl section vocabulary) or source category (repository language); null when the source has no classified topic.

updatedAt.description: Content row update instant when known.

url.description: Primary URL for this content card.

year.description: Best-effort content year used by the year filter.

ContentCompliance.description: Derived character/word counts and whether the row text meets its governed type contract (word/character limits and paragraph shape). violation lists each unmet rule and is empty when the row is compliant.

characterCount.description: Character count of the row text (UTF-16 units).

meetsRequirements.description: Whether the text satisfies every governed contract rule.

violation.description: One human-readable reason per unmet rule; empty when compliant.

wordCount.description: Word count of the row text (whitespace-separated tokens).

ContentEmbeddingActivity.description: Owner embedding-row creation, embedding recalculation, and semantic-similarity refresh activity for one source group. Entity includes entity, product, and service source partitions.

createdDailyAverage7d.description: Average owner embedding rows first created per day over seven days

createdLast24h.description: Owner embedding rows first created during the last 24 hours

recalculatedDailyAverage7d.description: Average existing owner embedding rows recalculated per day over the trailing seven days

recalculatedLast15m.description: Existing owner embedding rows whose embedding vector was recalculated during the last 15 minutes

recalculatedLast24h.description: Existing owner embedding rows recalculated during the last 24 hours

similarityRefreshedDailyAverage7d.description: Average owner embedding rows whose semantic-similarity cache watermark was refreshed per day over the trailing seven days

similarityRefreshedLast15m.description: Owner embedding rows whose semantic-similarity cache watermark was refreshed during the last 15 minutes

similarityRefreshedLast24h.description: Owner embedding rows whose semantic-similarity cache watermark was refreshed during the last 24 hours

ContentEmbeddingBacklog.description: Content embedding primary and owner reconciliation status, updated-owner scan state, refresh-work counts, and recent owner embedding activity.

activity.description: Owner embedding-row creation, embedding recalculation, and semantic-similarity refresh counts by source group. Excludes section and semantic-similarity fanout rows.

batchSize.description: Effective max items submitted by the reconciler per recurring tick

clusterMode.description: Active durable cluster admission mode. The value is never substituted with a configuration default.

configuredDefaultEnabled.description: Whether profile configuration permits live execution of both recurring embedding jobs. This is a runtime gate, not only a startup default.

outstanding.description: Owners with no embedding row, broken out by embedding source-type. The entity bucket is broken down further by typeRecord (Company, Investment Firm, Fund, etc.); product, service, person, and article are single rows. Excludes owners whose embedding exists with a stale model_version or regime; those source rows surface under work.previousEmbedding. Owner reconciliation reports this missing-owner component whether updatedOwnerScanEnabled is false or true.

ownerReconcileInterval.description: Configured owner-reconcile interval as an ISO-8601 duration

ownerReconcileScheduled.description: Whether the persisted JobRunr row for owner reconciliation is enabled. It repairs missing owners and removes absent or ineligible embedding rows independently of updatedOwnerScanEnabled.

pendingSize.description: Current in-memory refresh-lane item count (work already submitted)

pendingTargetSize.description: Effective max pending backlog target for recurring runs

queuedWorkSize.description: Pending notification-driven refresh items still persisted in the control-plane work queue. This is the true outstanding backlog the recurring reconciler must drain, distinct from the in-memory `pendingSize` lane depth.

reconcileInterval.description: Configured primary reconcile interval as an ISO-8601 duration

reconcileScheduled.description: Whether the persisted JobRunr row for primary stale-source reconciliation is enabled.

refreshEnabled.description: Whether embedding refresh execution is globally enabled

updatedOwnerScanEnabled.description: Whether the expensive updated-owner child-pulse scan is enabled. Owner reconciliation continues independently.

work.description: Exact refresh-work counts from embedding rows. Includes stale model/regime embeddings and stale semantic-similarity watermarks; excludes refresh-check cadence because it is continuous rotation rather than finite backlog.

ContentEmbeddingBacklogTypeCount.description: Outstanding missing-embedding count for one source-type (and optional typeRecord) bucket

missingCount.description: Number of owners with no embedding row

typeRecord.description: Entity classification when sourceType=entity. Null for product, service, person, and newsArticle buckets.

ContentEmbeddingBacklogWork.description: Exact pending refresh work count for one source-type and refresh-work lane.

pendingCount.description: Number of source rows pending for this refresh-work lane

ContentEmbeddingBacklogWorkType.description: Finite refresh-work lane represented by the backlog report.

ContentEmbeddingClusterMode.description: Cluster-wide admission mode for content-embedding and similarity work.

computedAt.description: Timestamp when the embedding row was computed.

cosineDistance.description: pgvector cosine distance where lower is closer.

cosineScore.description: Cosine similarity score where higher is closer.

modelVersion.description: Embedding model/profile version for this row.

rank.description: One-based semantic rank within the returned ANN candidate set.

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the source content.

sourceJson.description: Serialized JSONB source document stored for the embedding row.

sourceText.description: Source text used to compute the stored embedding.

ContentEmbeddingMutation.description: Create/update payload for content embedding writes

qwen4bFp16.description: Embedding vector pinned to qwen-4b-fp16 (Qwen3-Embedding-4B-f16.gguf) from https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B-GGUF?show_file_info=Qwen3-Embedding-4B-f16.gguf; only this fp16 model is accepted and exactly 2560 floats are required

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 hash of the source content

sourceJson.description: Serialized JSON payload stored in JSONB

sourceText.description: Source text used to create the embedding

aggregateCosineScore.description: Aggregate fused-vector cosine score used for ANN candidate retrieval.

compositeScore.description: Ranking score combining aggregate, shared sections, and coverage.

cosineScore.description: Aggregate fused-vector cosine score; preserved as the compatibility score.

coverageScore.description: Comparable section coverage shared by the source and target records.

matchedSectionWeight.description: Matched canonical section weight shared by the source and target records.

sectionScore.description: Weighted cosine score across section vectors present on both records.

sharedSectionCount.description: Number of canonical sections present on both records.

ContentEmbeddingOwnerActivity.description: An entity or person whose content embedding was created or recalculated within the activity window, including the embedding-generation watermark through which its semantic-similarity cache is current.

createdAt.description: When the owner embedding row was first created

name.description: Owner display name (entity brand/legal name or person full name)

recomputedAt.description: When the embedding vector was last recomputed; null when never recalculated since creation

similarityRefreshedAt.description: Embedding generation through which the semantic-similarity cache was refreshed; copied from the embedding computation timestamp after a successful refresh, not the refresh completion time; null when no generation has been refreshed

slug.description: Owner slug for linking; null when the owner has no slug

sourceId.description: Canonical owner id (entity or person UUID)

ContentFilter.description: Canonical filters for public content cards.

ContentRelation.description: How a content card relates to an entity or person owner.

ContentSearchInterpretation.description: Structured interpretation of a natural-language content search.

confidence.description: Planner confidence in the structured interpretation.

filter.description: Canonical content filter generated from the query.

interpretation.description: Human-readable summary of how the query was interpreted.

unsupported.description: Unsupported constraint, or null when all were translated.

ContentSearchResult.description: Natural-language content search result: planner interpretation plus page.

interpretation.description: Structured interpretation used to run the content query.

ContentSortField.description: Sortable fields for public content cards.

ContentSourceType.description: Discriminator for unified content embedding source partitions

ContentType.description: Public source family for canonical content cards.

failureReason.description: Failure reason when the crawl failed

DatasourceAgentIdentity.description: Validated automated-agent attribution for a write request. Travels on agentChassis and agentModel query parameters; actorType is not required at the OpenAPI/HTTP layer only because the web boundary infers actorType=agent from this complete pair before the domain factory and persistence write lane enforce actor context. Chassis is a CLI/SDK token, modelFamily is the derived LLM family prefix, and model is the full model identifier.

model.description: Full agent model identifier with the family prefix preserved.

modelFamily.description: Model family derived from the leading token of the model identifier.

DatasourceDataSourceType.description: Full read/storage source type for field-level provenance rows. Write query parameters use DatasourceWritableDataSourceType.

DatasourceProvenanceActor.description: Authenticated actor that authored a provenance write event

DatasourceProvenanceActorType.description: Actor boundary for a provenance write event

DatasourceProvenanceFieldChange.description: One changed field inside a provenance write event

DatasourceProvenanceOperation.description: Write operation captured by a provenance event row

DatasourceProvenanceSource.description: Write provenance supplied on mutation query parameters.

actorType.description: Actor type; inferred as agent when agentChassis and agentModel are supplied, or as employee from an authenticated user JWT session.

agentChassis.description: Agent chassis token for agent-authored writes.

agentModel.description: Agent model id for agent-authored writes.

sourceDetail.description: Source detail or reviewer reference for the write.

sourceProvider.description: Provider name for provider-native IDs or slugs.

DatasourceProvenanceStatus.description: Confidence and dispute state of a field-level provenance row

DatasourceSourceMetadata.description: Grouped source/provenance metadata for private v1 response fields

DatasourceTrackedProvenanceTable.description: Domain resource whose field-level provenance is tracked

DatasourceWritableDataSourceType.description: Source types accepted on provenance write query parameters.

DecimalRange.description: Decimal range for monetary and numeric filter criteria

max.description: Inclusive maximum decimal number, such as 220000 or 123456.78.

min.description: Inclusive minimum decimal number, such as 220000 or 123456.78.

DeleteMode.description: Deletion behavior for media assets and mutable resources

DomainConflictDetails.description: Polymorphic envelope for RFC 9457 ProblemDetail.details on HTTP 409 responses. The concrete variant depends on the conflict kind: URL ownership collisions return UrlDuplicateConflict; ambiguous strict URL lookups return StrictUrlLookupConflict; create-time duplicate review gates return DuplicateCreateReview; classification writes that touch an inactive tag bucket return ClassificationInactiveTagDetails; news publication+URL uniqueness violations return NewsSourceUrlConflict. Inspect ProblemDetail.code/type and the field set present on details to identify the variant.

DuplicateCreateReview.description: Candidate-review conflict details returned in ProblemDetail.details for create gates and deterministic lookup ambiguity. The returned candidates are the decision surface: update the matching candidate, create with duplicate override only when every candidate is distinct from the source-backed target, or block when identity is unresolved. score and threshold rank review priority; they are not proof that the requested record is absent.

candidate.description: Entity/person candidates returned by lookup or create duplicate review. If a candidate is the requested record, read/update that candidate by id. Create with duplicate override only after every candidate is reviewed as distinct.

newsCandidate.description: News candidates returned by lookup or create duplicate review. If a candidate is the requested article, read/update that article by id. Otherwise block until source evidence proves a distinct article.

overridePath.description: Create endpoint to retry only after reviewing the returned candidates and supplying overrideGate=duplicate and overrideReason as query parameters. Null for detail lookup ambiguity, where the next action is review/update/block.

threshold.description: Review threshold used by duplicate scoring. Scores below this value can still be useful candidate context; this value does not prove absence or authorize create.

DuplicateUrlCandidate.description: Typed URL signal used for duplicate detection

EmployeeCount.description: Employee-count time-series point for an entity

Entity.description: Flat entity core record — identity, naming, status, image, and source metadata. An entity is our umbrella record for organizations such as companies, funds, investment firms and investors, accelerators, nonprofits, and government agencies, plus products and services connected to those organizations. Returned directly by thin-mode (?mode=thin) and alphabetical (?letter=X) list endpoints. Nested as .core inside EntityList for default list reads and EntityDetail for detail reads.

lastModifiedAt.description: Provenance-grounded last-modified watermark (schema.org dateModified). Advances only when a real, consumer-meaningful data point changes via a recorded provenance event — never on timestamp-only writes, migrations, or index refreshes. Pairs with createdAt (dateCreated) and grounds the sitemap lastmod.

nameAlias.description: All names this entity has been known by — current alternates, DBAs, former names, and rebrand-source identities. Naming history (e.g. `Metaphor Systems` for the current `Exa` entity) lives here; never as a separate relationship type or `formerName` field.

operatingStatus.description: Current operating status. Use Acquired Subsidiary when the entity was acquired and still operates; use Closed (Acquihire) when the entity was acquired for its team and shut down, rendering like Closed everywhere; use Acquired only when it is terminal, folded, or closed.

publicId.description: Stable, immutable public handle (e.g. `eV1StGXR8Z5a`). Never changes once assigned, unlike the slug. Null on projections that do not select it and on rows still awaiting handle backfill.

publicUrl.description: Absolute public profile URL on the aVenture front-end, e.g. `https://aventure.vc/non-profits/{slug}`, derived from the typeRecord's canonical route family. Null when the route needs relationship context or the record has no direct public SSR route (Business Line, Organization, Product, Service, or a non-public slug). EntityDetail.publicUrl resolves Business Line parent context. Product/Service pages are provider-nested: compose the provider entity's publicUrl + `/products-services/` + this record's slug, or consume the sitemap-urls slot paths, which already emit the composed child routes.

sitemap.description: Sub-route eligibility, populated by the sitemap projection. Null on non-sitemap reads to keep thin payloads compact.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier

EntityAcceleratorParticipation.description: Flattened accelerator participation derived from acceleratorParticipant relationship rows and joined to the canonical accelerator entity.

accelerator.description: Canonical thin accelerator entity from the acceleratorParticipant relationship

acceleratorName.description: Full accelerator participation name, including program detail

id.description: Stable participation identifier anchored to the contributing acceleratorParticipant relationship

program.description: Accelerator program name, when the source distinguishes one

EntityAcquisition.description: Canonical acquisition event: scoped entity is acquired, acquirerEntity is buyer, and status is read stage -- Acquisition before operating-status change, Acquired Subsidiary for active completed brands, Acquired for terminal/folded/closed (including Closed (Acquihire)).

acquiredEntity.description: Acquired company — read-only nested display projection of the scoped path entity.

acquirerEntity.description: Buyer — read-only nested display projection. Mutations identify the buyer only via the flat acquirerEntityId UUID, never a nested entity object.

investorJoinId.description: Type-safe identifier for fundraise investor joins

status.description: Read stage, not transactionStatus: Acquisition before operating-status change; Acquired Subsidiary for active completed acquisitions; Acquired for terminal/folded/closed (including Closed (Acquihire)).

EntityAcquisitionEvidence.description: Booleans confirming each managed row written by the acquisition endpoint.

EntityAcquisitionMutation.description: Canonical acquisition write payload. Use with the entity acquisitions endpoint where the path entityId is the acquired company and acquirerEntityId is the buyer.

acquirerEntityId.description: Buyer/acquirer entity id. Must differ from the acquired entityId path segment.

amount.description: Acquisition amount in currency units (full units, not minor); requires currency when supplied.

announcedAt.description: Announced acquisition date as an ISO offset date-time, date, year-month, or year. Coarse values normalize to the UTC period start; original precision is not persisted.

asOf.description: Effective date when announcedAt and completedAt are absent

completedAt.description: Completed acquisition date as an ISO offset date-time, date, year-month, or year. Coarse values normalize to the UTC period start; original precision is not persisted.

source.description: Source URL or compact source label copied to the relationship row

EntityAcquisitionRole.description: Role of the path entity in the acquisition. Defaults to acquired (the company that was bought). Pass acquirer to list acquisitions made by the path entity, or all to list both sides in one page.

EntityAcquisitionStage.description: Acquisition stage/status values used by acquisition APIs and fundraise rollups. Acquisition is neutral before operating-status change; Acquired Subsidiary is completed and still operating; Acquired is terminal or folded, including Closed (Acquihire).

EntityClassification.description: Entity classification join rows grouped by bucket; default reads include only current joins, and includeInactive=true adds inactive/historical joins.

geoLocationExposure.description: Geographic markets where the entity earns revenue and serves customers (e.g. North America, EMEA, APAC). This is the sales/market footprint classification — NOT the HQ or office location. HQ and office locations belong on the address record (enrichment.address), not this bucket. A London-headquartered company selling globally should have North America and EMEA here, not United Kingdom.

standardizedClassification.description: Standardized classification joins from res_classification_ref. Rows are join-existing-only and carry category/code metadata.

EntityClassificationInactiveTagOverride.description: Caller-chosen handling when the canonical classification value exists but is dormant.

EntityClassificationMutation.description: Create or update an entity classification. Use tagId for an existing tag, standardizedClassificationId for an existing standardized classification, or type and name for a creatable editorial value.

inactiveTagOverride.description: Dormant-value handling when type plus name matches an inactive catalog row. Omitted reactivates the dormant value by default (it becomes current and the write returns a Warning header naming the reactivated tag). Set ATTACH_INACTIVE to attach the dormant value without reactivating it.

isCurrent.description: Current join row. Create and replace default to true when omitted.

isPrimary.description: Primary tag within its bucket. Create and replace default to false when omitted.

name.description: Source-backed classification value; requires type and is mutually exclusive with tagId and standardizedClassificationId.

standardizedClassificationId.description: Existing standardized classification id from res_classification_ref. Mutually exclusive with tagId and with the type+name pair.

tagId.description: Existing active classification tag id. Mutually exclusive with type and name (and with standardizedClassificationId): provide either tagId alone or the type+name pair, never both.

type.description: Writable classification bucket; requires name and is mutually exclusive with tagId and standardizedClassificationId.

EntityClassificationSuggestion.description: Ranked classification suggestion derived from the enriched entity profile and classification centroid embeddings. Returned by the default classification discovery endpoint before callers create source-backed classification joins.

alreadyJoined.description: True when the entity already has a current or historical matching join.

classification.description: Suggested writable editorial tag or standardized classification code candidate.

creatable.description: Whether a missing editorial tag value may be created with type plus name instead of tagId.

rank.description: One-based rank within this suggestion response.

score.description: Composite embedding similarity score; larger values rank higher.

writable.description: Whether this suggestion can be joined through the classification mutation endpoint.

EntityComparisonSignals.description: Competitive comparison signals for a provider entity — sells-to customers, pricing model, ownership, funding stage, total raised, and website. Projected from entity enrichment for side-by-side comparison; founded year rides the entity core.

sellsTo.description: Customer types the provider sells to (current typeCustomer tags)

EntityCreate.description: Canonical request body for creating a new entity. Carries the entity payload plus its URL set; duplicate detection runs server-side and returns a conflict envelope when potential matches exist. Override review gates with GateOverride query parameters after reviewing 409 ProblemDetail.details.candidate from the original create conflict.

urlLink.description: Initial URL links. Required except for eponymous Product/Service creates when research finds no distinct official page URL that describes the product/service.

EntityCreateLogo.description: Logo imported or attached during entity create, requiring agent audit.

media.description: Managed R2/imgproxy image requiring agent audit

sourceImageUrl.description: Image URL recorded as logo provenance. For remote imports this is the source image URL; for manual uploads this is the managed CDN URL of the persisted upload.

EntityCreateLogoSource.description: Source used for the entity create logo.

EntityCreateResult.description: Entity create confirmation. `entity` is the persisted detail returned by the write and is the identity proof for the created row. New entities normally remain hidden from public list/detail reads until visibility promotion. `importedLogo` is present only when the create attached a logo. Manual logo failures reject the create; automatic website-logo import is opportunistic and may be absent so Phase 1 identity creation can succeed.

entity.description: Persisted entity detail after create, including the canonical id, slug, status, text, classification, URL, and relationship sections returned by the write.

importedLogo.description: Logo import details requiring agent audit when present

EntityDetail.description:
Full entity detail response: core entity, enrichment, governed research,
        relationships, external identifiers, fundraising, news, people, and sitemap eligibility.
        Core identity and naming fields live under core.

core.description: Core entity identity, naming, status, image, and source metadata.

enrichment.description: Entity enrichment: addresses, classification, funding summary, text, and URL links.

fundraiseRound.description: Fundraise rounds associated with this entity.

newsArticle.description: News articles associated with this entity.

publicUrl.description: Absolute canonical public URL when this detail has a renderable public route.

research.description: Combined research disclosure: governed detail rows, snippets, and accelerator participation.

sitemap.description: Sub-route eligibility computed once at the persistence boundary.

uniqueId.description: External registry identifiers associated with this entity.

EntityDetailBatch.description: Batch request for entity detail retrieval by id, slug, or current joined URL

slug.description: Entity slug values

EntityDetailCoverage.description: Per-entity completion-gate coverage: for each evaluated gate, whether the assembled entity detail already satisfies it and how to obtain it when it does not.

entityId.description: Canonical entity UUID this coverage describes.

slot.description: One coverage row per evaluated gate: flat entity-level gates, plus one indexed row per associated person or Product/Service child for gates that repeat by parent.

EntityDetailCoverageSlot.description: One completion gate evaluated against the assembled entity detail.

count.description: Resolved row/value count backing this gate.

coverage.description: Coverage verdict for this gate on the assembled detail. NOT_EVALUABLE means the detail does not carry the gate, so it is neither satisfied nor unsatisfied here — grade it from owningRead instead of treating it as an unmet gate.

howToObtain.description: What to do to obtain this gate when it is not present.

owningRead.description: OpenAPI operationId of the canonical read that proves the gate.

parentPersonId.description: Parent person this slot was instantiated for when indexed per person. Null on flat and Product/Service-indexed gates. Two per-person slots sharing a gateId are distinguished by this id; per-person slots remain advisory rather than required.

parentProductServiceId.description: Parent Product/Service this slot was instantiated for when indexed per offering. Null on flat and per-person gates. Required Product/Service slots sharing a gateId are addressed independently by this id.

required.description: Whether this read can decide and demand the gate. True for mandatory flat-floor gates and for server-decidable indexed Product/Service gates. False for indexed per-person slots: their source-backed unobtainable relief lives only in the run completion ledger, so the server cannot terminally decide them.

unobtainableAllowed.description: Whether the governed completion contract permits source-backed unobtainable evidence to relieve this exact absent slot.

EntityDuplicateCriteria.description: Canonical entity duplicate-check criteria. URL matching stays strict when urlStrictness is omitted; clients can opt into broader matching with loose or any.

excludeId.description: Entity id to exclude from duplicate candidates; not a lookup id

productServiceProviderId.description: Provider entity UUID that scopes Product/Service duplicate candidates to that provider's current productService catalog, including hidden rows. Product and Service slugs are provider-pair scoped, so cross-provider name reuse is not a duplicate; supply this id to review the one catalog that can collide.

qwen4bFp16Embedding.description: Embedding vector pinned to qwen-4b-fp16 (Qwen3-Embedding-4B-f16.gguf) from https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3-Embedding-4B-GGUF?show_file_info=Qwen3-Embedding-4B-f16.gguf; only this fp16 model is accepted and exactly 2560 floats are required

slug.description: URL-safe identifier

urlStrictness.description: Optional URL match strictness. Omit for strict matching. Send loose or any only when the caller intentionally widens URL matching.

EntityEnrichment.description: Supplemental entity data — addresses, classification tags, funding, text content, and URL links

classification.description: Entity classification join projection for this read surface. Single-detail and full-detail batch reads include full history; list, default batch, and similar-entity reads may filter to current joins. Use GET /v1/entities/{entityId}/classifications?includeInactive=true for authoritative join history.

EntityFilter.description: Entity list and search filters. GET flattens these fields as query parameters; POST accepts the same shape as JSON.

affinity.description: Affinity provider organization names accepted by the companies list filter. Affinity rows are member -> provider; use provider names here, not member names.

employeeCountRange.description: Inclusive reported employee-count ranges, in employees.

entityId.description: Restrict results to specific entity IDs.

entityName.description: Exact normalized match against entity brand or legal names.

hasFundraising.description: Filter to entities with fundraise activity.

letter.description: First letter of the display name.

portfolioHeadquartersState.description: Portfolio-company headquarters state or region values.

slug.description: Restrict results to entity slugs.

items.description: Canonical lowercase URL slug for the resource

suppressNonOperating.description: Suppress entities with terminal operating status.

suppressZeroTotalRaised.description: Suppress entities whose total raised is zero.

textSearch.description: Non-blank keyword/full-text search term. Use natural-search for plain-English or multi-constraint company requests.

typeRecord.description: Entity type filter. Organization expands to Company, Investment Firm, Nonprofit, and Government; omit to include every entity type.

url.description: Current URL to match by normalized host and path.

urlDomain.description: Current root domain to match when urlMatchMode=domain.

urlMatchMode.description: URL matching mode: hostPath uses host and path; domain uses the root domain.

urlType.description: Restrict URL matching to one URL type.

yearFoundedRange.description: Inclusive founding-year ranges, in calendar years.

scope.description: Optional numeric scope for the option

name.description: Tag name values to filter counts

choiceOptionTotal.description: Total eligible choice option values for this filter

choiceOptionTruncated.description: Whether additional eligible choices exist beyond choiceOption

controlType.description: Control type used to render the filter

scope.description: Optional numeric scope for the filter

country.description: Countries with their states and cities

city.description: Cities within the state; empty when only states were requested

EntityFilterLogoOption.description: Logo sort priority for entity search

ui.description: UI metadata for rendering entity filter controls

EntityFilterOptionSet.description: Available filter options for list endpoints

filtersMeta.description: Metadata for the generated filter option set

distributionKey.description: Filter keys that include distribution data

includePrivate.description: Whether private filter options are included

includedTypeRecord.description: Entity type records included in the filter payload

optionMode.description: Option mode used to generate option lists

filter.description: Canonical filter entries for the active entity scope.

meta.description: Pagination and degradation state for this refinement.

scopeFilter.description: Entity filter scope applied to the option search
